snowboardingProfilesRideTest.evidence: Page updated 2026-09-28; actual demo disclosed as CAPiTA Dark Horse 2026, 154 cm, tested 2025-03-17. Rider 183 cm / 82 kg / US boot 10, used a 535 mm centered stance. Conditions: groomed snow about 75% firm bordering on icy and 25% softer over mid-firm; off-piste tracked fresh and small untracked pockets, no deep powder. Review describes easy turn initiation/slashing, agility and spins, moderate speed stability (not a point-and-shoot board), decent crud stability, poor deep-powder suitability, forgiving jump landings and low catch feel. Tester measured that sample at 2620 g, which is not entered as 2027 production weight. External numeric score is not mapped to site scores.

boardOfTheWorldRideTest.evidence: Review says its sample was 2026 Dark Horse 154; reviewer disclosed 144 lb, 5 ft 6 in, men's US boot 9. Reports medium longitudinal flex 6/10 with softer torsional feel 4.5/10, jump/side-hit capability and catch forgiveness, while not suited to deep powder and less stable than the DOA at speed. Its score framework is not mapped to site scores.

2027CatalogComparison.evidence: 2027 lineup comparison says Dark Horse shape, sizes, flex, camber, core, fiberglass and base are unchanged from 2026, but its listed carbon-aramid boosters change from two 30 mm to two 20 mm. This conflicts with CAPiTA's currently published 2027 product page, which still lists 2 x 30 mm; preserve as an unresolved manufacturer/current-catalog discrepancy, not as a confirmed change.

scoringReview.decision: Adjust float 5.8→4.8 and forgiveness 7.8→8.0 as directional editorial judgments, not conversions of external scores. The 2026 154 ride tests report only shallow leftovers and explicitly poor deep-powder suitability, supporting a lower float estimate. Low-catch feel and forgiving jump landings support a small forgiveness increase. Keep stability 7.0 and response 7.2: the review describes moderate but not bomb-proof speed stability plus easy turning, without enough grounds for numeric recalibration. Keep park 8.6 as consistent with jumps/spins/side-hits, and retain value 8.2 only as a low-confidence estimate because CNY 3600 has no established market or price-type source. Target-year carryover is plausible because a reviewer says core/shape/flex/profile/base are unchanged, but the 2027 carbon-booster width has a catalog discrepancy, so overall confidence remains low-to-medium and 2026 is not claimed as a 2027 direct test.
scoringReview.confidence: low-to-medium for direction only; one-day 2026 154 tests, target-year carbon-booster discrepancy; low for value
